scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./apps/**" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.demo:build: pnpm --filter @tahaqqaq/web run build && pnpm --filter @tahaqqaq/api exec esbuild src/lib/verification.ts --bundle --minify --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=../../tahaqqaq-preview/verification.mjs && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.rmSync('tahaqqaq-preview/app',{recursive:true,force:true});fs.cpSync('apps/web/dist/public','tahaqqaq-preview/app',{recursive:true})"
